mage_0.title: Mage
mage_0.description: Enter the Mage region. +20 maximum mana. Branches can be combined with other class regions.

rogue_0.title: Rogue

rogue_6.title: Shadow Memory
rogue_6.description: +3% movement speed and +2 percentage points critical chance.

ranger_0.title: Ranger

awakening.title: The Forgotten Warrior
awakening.description: +3 generic.attack damage. +2 generic.max health. 5% generic.movement speed.

mage_14.title: Living Grimoire

mage_16.title: Warden of Runes
mage_16.description: Spellblade capstone: +2 health, +1 melee damage and +2 stamina.

mage_18.title: Master of the Veil
mage_18.description: Mage mastery: +10% spell power and +10% mana regeneration. Requires 16 spent points.

ranger_12.title: Scout
ranger_12.description: +2 generic.max health. 2% generic.movement speed. +1 bow damage.

ranger_16.title: Wildstride
ranger_16.description: Scout capstone: +3% movement, +2 stamina and +5% arrow damage.

ranger_18.title: Horizon Walker
ranger_18.description: Ranger mastery: +5% arrow damage, +2 health and +2% movement. Requires 16 spent points.

warrior_14.title: Bastion
warrior_14.description: Vanguard capstone: +4 health, +1 armor and +1 stun armor.

warrior_18.title: Oathkeeper
warrior_18.description: +2 generic.max health. +1.5 generic.attack damage. +1 generic.armor toughness.

rogue_9.title: Assassin
rogue_9.description: +10 percentage points critical damage and +0.5 melee damage.

rogue_14.title: Deathmark
rogue_14.description: Assassin capstone: +3 percentage points critical chance and +15 percentage points critical damage.

rogue_16.title: Blade Dancer
rogue_16.description: Duelist capstone: +3% movement, +2 stamina and +0.5 melee damage.

rogue_18.title: Ghost of the Oath
rogue_18.description: Rogue mastery: +2% movement, +0.5 melee damage and +2 stamina. Requires 16 spent points.

mage_19.title: Blink
mage_19.description: Short-range teleport. Unlock and right-click the Blink Sigil to blink up to five blocks forward when the destination is clear. 12-second cooldown.

mage_21.title: Mana Siphon
mage_21.description: Passive: +10% mana regeneration and +5% spell power.

ranger_19.title: Windrunner
ranger_19.description: Right-click the Windrunner Sigil for Speed II and Slow Falling for 5 seconds. 15-second cooldown.

ranger_21.title: Hunter's Mark
ranger_21.description: Right-click the Hunter's Mark Sigil to reveal nearby non-player mobs for 6 seconds. 20-second cooldown.

warrior_19.title: Berserk
warrior_19.description: While holding a sword, axe or mace, right-click the Berserk Sigil to gain Rage: +10% attack damage and +15% attack speed for 8 seconds. 20-second cooldown.

rogue_19.title: Double Jump
rogue_19.description: While airborne, right-click the Double Jump Sigil for a second upward burst. 10-second cooldown.

rogue_20.title: Shadowstep
rogue_20.description: Right-click the Shadowstep Sigil to blink up to three blocks forward and turn invisible for 2 seconds. 16-second cooldown.

rogue_21.title: Evasive Footwork
rogue_21.description: Passive: +12% movement speed and +5% attack speed.
